papers.paper_title: StreamForge: Adaptive Stream Ingestion for Lakehouse Systems
papers.authors: Jason Hernandez, Priya Raman, Daniel Osei
papers.abstract: StreamForge studies adaptive micro-batch sizing for lakehouse ingestion and shows that workload-aware batching reduces end-to-end latency without sacrificing exactly-once guarantees.

papers.paper_title: QueryLens: Cost-Aware Query Rewriting with LLM Feedback
papers.authors: Jason Hernandez, Sofia Mendes, Kenji Watanabe
papers.abstract: QueryLens couples a cost model with language-model-generated rewrite candidates, keeping only rewrites whose estimated cost improves under the target warehouse statistics.

papers.paper_title: FastRank: Latency-Aware Ranking for Real-Time Feature Stores
papers.authors: Jason Hernandez, Amara Diallo, Lucas Ferreira
papers.abstract: FastRank explores latency-aware ranking strategies for feature-store serving, balancing freshness of features against tail latency in online recommendation workloads.

papers.paper_title: DataWeave: Declarative Orchestration for Heterogeneous Data Pipelines
papers.authors: Jason Hernandez, Mei Lin, Omar Haddad
papers.abstract: DataWeave introduces a declarative orchestration layer that compiles heterogeneous ETL pipelines into a unified execution plan across batch and streaming runtimes.

papers.paper_title: LedgerStream: Exactly-Once Change Data Capture at Scale
papers.authors: Jason Hernandez, Nora Petrov, Wei Zhang
papers.abstract: LedgerStream provides exactly-once change data capture over partitioned logs, using a lightweight ledger protocol to recover from partial failures without global locking.

papers.paper_title: GraphDBT: Graph-Aware Transformations for Analytical Workloads
papers.authors: Jason Hernandez, Elena Rossi, Tunde Adeyemi
papers.abstract: GraphDBT extends transformation tooling with graph-aware lineage analysis, allowing analysts to reason about join graphs and materialization strategies inside existing data build pipelines.

papers.paper_title: SynthBench: A Benchmark Suite for Synthetic Relational Data
papers.authors: Jason Hernandez, Hannah Cole, Ravi Menon
papers.abstract: SynthBench evaluates synthetic relational data generators along fidelity, privacy, and downstream utility axes, providing a reproducible benchmark harness for the data generation community.
